name: import-firefox-from-the-pane
description: The import pane previews the staged Firefox fixture and imports it. The fixture's places.sqlite files are in WAL mode, and its only session file is sessionstore-backups/recovery.jsonlz4, as a running Firefox leaves it. With Settings still open, the Engines pane already lists the imported engines. Settings then closes, the sidebar gains the Personal space, and a reopened Settings still counts the same Firefox files and still lists the engines from disk. The Firefox folder is the hand-built fixture in fixtures/import/firefox/basic.

actions.note: Atrium frontmost, or cmd+comma opens Finder Settings

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="import"]'); if (!item) { return 'no import rail item'; } item.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: evidence: the Firefox card with its counts, light mode

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.import-card[data-source="firefox"] .import-run'); if (!b) { return 'no button'; } b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()

actions.note: the run answered while Settings is open

actions.expression: (() => { const item = document.querySelector('.settings-rail-item[data-pane="engines"]'); if (!item) { return 'no rail'; } item.click(); return [...document.querySelectorAll('.engine-row .engine-keyword')].some((k) => k.textContent === 'docs') ? 'docs' : 'missing'; })()
actions.note: the open page took the saved settings, so its next save keeps the imported engines
evidence: the imported engines in the live Engines pane
